libsodium, vendored.

  upstream  https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium.git
  commit    2c61b49
  version   1.0.22

Checked in as source rather than as a submodule, deliberately: this is the
exact code the released binaries are built from, and a clone has to be able to
reproduce a build without reaching the network or trusting that upstream still
has that commit.

To verify it is unmodified upstream:

  git clone https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium.git /tmp/libsodium-check
  git -C /tmp/libsodium-check checkout 2c61b49
  diff -r --exclude=.git /tmp/libsodium-check third_party/libsodium
